stronger_claim_blockers.scope: Unqualified raw-semantic sameTEST equivalence to local Kev reference; does not block the seven-member converted-TEST report
stronger_claim_blockers.finding: The v7 full verifier authenticates converted KEV bytes and their task semantics. It does not reconstruct the original reference conversion or verify reference input/definition/clean-mask equivalence. Prior saved ordered identity and declared original hashes remain useful but narrower evidence.
stronger_claim_blockers.minimum: Retain the reference comparison as descriptive saved-item alignment with this limitation; a stronger equivalence claim requires an independently authenticated original-to-converted source/semantic mapping, without new inference or model selection.

stronger_claim_blockers.scope: Claim that legacy reference audit is historically terminal-authenticated
stronger_claim_blockers.finding: Prior reference alignment explicitly records absent legacy audit-SHA terminal binding.
stronger_claim_blockers.minimum: Retain that qualification. Do not create or imply retrospective historical proof.

limitations: Acceptance covers the fixed seven-member same converted TEST populations and frozen Track K/report protocol. It is not a new model, seed, checkpoint, harness or threshold selection; PT remains a control and QO remains the dropped-input control.

The actual consumer rebuilt the full numerical fields using frozen primitives shared with the producer. This review independently audited execution/artifact bindings, hashes, exact vectors and prior independent arithmetic; it did not execute a second full raw-source metric reconstruction or issue a ticket.

Raw converted train/calibration/TEST/variant files and manifest were rehashed against the consumer source snapshots; they were not parsed by this reviewer. This proves byte continuity under the accepted source/launcher boundary, not original dataset annotation correctness or semantic equivalence to an external reference interface.

The source/full-metric verifier return detail is not persisted as a standalone verbose receipt: the adapter retains vectors and source-reference snapshots, and successful completed transaction/EXIT is evidence that the exact reviewed mandatory verifier path returned. Do not describe a separately persisted per-field verification transcript.

Bootstrap intervals are the pre-existing question-level paired 90% intervals: 10000 resamples, NumPy default_rng(20261030), linear percentiles, seeds averaged within question before resampling. Decision has 1200 questions in 960 record stems; no record-cluster or training-seed population uncertainty, multiplicity adjustment or new CI gate.

Only K0 permutation measurements carry the untrained-invariance interpretation. Trained arms saw shuffling and their permutation results are sanity checks. Always retain both-sides-correct and NOTA present/absent discrimination counterparts; low flip rates alone are degenerate-compatible.

All duplicate-option audits return zero with vacuous=true. This dataset supplies no positive duplicate-option challenge. Uniform exact-zero r0 accuracy comes from all-score ties and the frozen tie rule; constant/uniform equality across models is by design.

Operator accuracy and C-branch rates are harness statements, not standalone model uncertainty/refusal measurements. All 656 transfer rows use the default tau 0.5 tier; no transfer-specific calibration improvement is established.

Primary transfer ECE worsens versus Base even though clean accuracy improves. QO low ECE and its exact clean/question-only equality do not establish input understanding; identical dropped-input scoring is not independent replication.

External Kev comparison retains saved-item correspondence and descriptive arithmetic only: original-source-to-converted semantic input/definition/mask equivalence is not newly authenticated by this consumer. Native T=2.3510958125672174 remains separate from T=1, and upstream release values are not local prediction operands.

The historical local reference audit has no audit-SHA terminal binding; present hashing cannot create that historical binding. Final item probability-loss vectors are not exported, so external probability differences remain aggregate, without paired loss inference.

DEV adverse findings remain: primary boolean B2 void; samechip/diffchip repeat boolean B2 fail; samechip transfer noise >1 pp was diagnostic. Final clean gains do not erase these or support a general consistency/mechanism claim.

Process identity uses recorded PID/boot/start-tick/command/environment plus accepted v7 launcher controls. The review did not witness the now-exited processes live or prove absence of every unobserved external rewrite. Parent authority and model routing are externally authenticated.

No production artifact is rewritten to scientific_acceptance=true. The completed producer/consumer artifacts deliberately retain false; this independent review is the scientific assessment for the scoped report, and does not perform publication, deployment, commit or push.

reference_mapping_addendum.scope: Data mapping and descriptive matched-source local-reference comparison for already consumed decision-v7 TEST1200 and transfer-v4 TEST656 only; prior seven-member report remains accepted unchanged.
reference_mapping_addendum.publication_safe_wording: For the previously consumed decision-v7 TEST1200 and transfer-v4 TEST656 populations, an independent read-only audit authenticated the exact clean-question mask and the original-reference-to-converted data mapping for all 1,856 questions, including rendered inputs and instructions, ordered candidate IDs/names/definitions, and gold labels. The reconstructed converted files are byte-identical to the frozen files bound to all seven accepted final vectors. These results support the existing descriptive local-reference comparison on matched source questions under explicitly different input/output interfaces. They do not establish prompt-byte, tokenization, attention-mask, architectural, numerical or cross-hardware equivalence. The final prompt strips outer whitespace on 36 decision input rows, one transfer input row and eight transfer candidate definitions. The legacy reference audit still lacks an audit-SHA terminal binding; current envelope and EXPECTED hashes do not create historical terminal authentication.
residual_bounds: Acceptance closes only the original-reference-to-converted data-field/mask/render mapping gap for the already consumed two clean TEST populations. It does not modify the prior seven-member scientific acceptance or reopen selection.

Historical reference terminal binds config stamp and suite row/report hashes. It does not separately bind the legacy audit SHA, EXPECTED file bytes or per-record envelope file bytes. Their present hashes and embedded commitments support current consistency, not independently witnessed historical creation or absence of an unobserved rewrite.

Pure API replay uses namespace objects and observed JSONContent; the full Pydantic/serving/model/tokenizer stack was not independently executed. Source inspection traces LocalPredictor through materialize/api_request/to_record; no opt-in date-facts transform occurs on the inspected reference driver path.

Inputs/instructions/option shown text map exactly at the audited data/API-render level. Added task definition, one row per question, fallback duplication, score-text duplication, false/true IDs with no/yes names, final option bullets/colons/answer cue and label continuation are explicit interface transformations. No serialized prompt-byte equivalence is claimed.

Outer whitespace counts are converted question-row counts: 36 decision input rows, one transfer input row, eight transfer definition options across two rows, zero question texts. These are retained differences, not silently normalized raw data or evidence that whitespace is behaviorally irrelevant.
QO is the existing dropped-input control; its binding to the converted dataset does not imply that it consumed input text. PT remains a control and the preselected primary remains unchanged.

Original annotation correctness, absence of leakage, reference checkpoint byte authentication, hidden runtime behavior, mechanism/architecture benefit and cross-hardware numerical equivalence are not newly established.

No new scores, probability arithmetic, uncertainty intervals, metric thresholds, selection or inference were produced. Prior T=1 descriptive comparison and its uncertainty limits remain; native T=2.3510958125672174 and upstream release metrics remain separate. Final item probability-loss vectors are not exported, so no new paired probability-loss claim follows.

All prior nonmapping scientific qualifications remain, including question-level rather than record-cluster/seed-population uncertainty, DEV adverse findings, shared metric primitives and limits of consistency claims.

Reads were limited to package evidence, its exact pinned sources/code/config/reports/envelopes and the seven prior-pinned final vectors. Nonclean original rows were inspected for count, canonical input commitment and exclusion/order only; no converted variants, train, calibration or development populations were opened.
